eyeIdentity: Front view: viewer-left original yellow-green, viewer-right pale blue. Anatomical left eye stays blue when turning; right-facing full profile shows the green eye and left-facing profile shows the blue eye. Closed eyes remain closed.
tailIdle: Reuses stand open/blink sprites and isolated tail layer. Random 10-20 second gaps after completion; two gentle cycles over two seconds; blink at the boundary of the cycles. Lowest automatic-animation priority, no replay of suppressed due events.
standingGaze: Runtime-only mouse gaze inside calibrated eye interiors. Original stand PNG and eye identities stay unchanged. All non-Stand poses retain authored expressions; closed eyes have no pupil overlay. Gaze uses smooth bounded motion, screen-to-visual coordinates and isolated transition snapshots. Calibration is documented in docs/animation-spec.md.
notes: Reference-derived RGBA pixel frames with ImageGen-approved heterochromic iris palette. Eye edits preserve every pixel outside audited iris masks. Both directional walk eye sets are pre-baked so mirroring cannot swap eye identity. Petting keeps unmirrored open-eye endpoints. Petted retains its three-second single paw sweep and exactly two independent tail cycles. FeedingFish reuses the authored left/right raised-paw sprites, adds a transparent ImageGen fish prop, runtime breakable string, eat/shrink timeline and one complete mouth-lick lap; its endpoints match Stand and whole-cat changes use compact blends. Soothing hand starts at ear level for both strokes and finishes at the original lower-body endpoint. Soothing timing remains two seconds of stroking followed directly by one second of lowering to sleep; no stretch or calculator-triggered animation. All state transitions retain the shared smootherstep policy. Original pre-update artwork is archived outside runtime assets.
